body:
This was already the case before that PR, but since probes would never reach full strength the sky was always blended in, so that transition wasn't as obvious, the sky was just everywhere :)

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/100241 fixes this, and you can see the same error as you have in the _"this pr"_ video on this comment: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/100241#issuecomment-2538415368

Those ambient light streaks you're seeing in the scene are the same as https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/99718, I haven't found the cause of this yet.
